children.description: The ring-tailed lemur (Lemur catta) is a medium- to larger-sized strepsirrhine (wet-nosed) primate and the most internationally recognized lemur species, owing to its long, black-and-white, ringed tail..

children.name: Eulemur
children.description: The brown and collared lemurs form the largest genus of Lemuridae, with 13 species distributed across Madagascar's forests from humid east to dry west and introduced to the Comoros. Many show striking sexual dichromatism, with males and females bearing conspicuously different coat colours. The former wide-ranging brown lemur (E. fulvus) has been split into multiple species through molecular and morphological studies.

children.name: Eulemur fulvus
children.description: The common brown lemur (Eulemur fulvus) is a species of lemur in the family Lemuridae..

children.name: Eulemur albifrons
children.description: The white-headed lemur (Eulemur albifrons), also known as the white-headed brown lemur, white-fronted brown lemur, or white-fronted lemur, is a species of primate in the family Lemuridae..

children.name: Eulemur sanfordi
children.description: Sanford's brown lemur (Eulemur sanfordi), or Sanford's lemur, is a species of strepsirrhine primate in the family Lemuridae..

children.name: Eulemur coronatus
children.description: The crowned lemur (Eulemur coronatus) is a lemur that is 31–36 cm (12–14 in) long and weighs 2 kg (4.4 lb)..

children.name: Eulemur macaco
children.description: The black lemur (Eulemur macaco) is a species of lemur from the family Lemuridae.

children.name: Eulemur flavifrons
children.description: The blue-eyed black lemur (Eulemur flavifrons), also known as the Sclater's lemur, is a species of true lemur..

children.name: Eulemur mongoz
children.description: The mongoose lemur (Eulemur mongoz) is a small primate in the family Lemuridae, native to Madagascar and introduced to the Comoros Islands.

children.name: Eulemur rubriventer
children.description: The red-bellied lemur (Eulemur rubriventer) is a medium-sized strepsirrhine primate with a luxuriant chestnut brown coat..

children.name: Eulemur rufus
children.description: The red lemur (Eulemur rufus), also known as the rufous brown lemur or northern red-fronted lemur, is a species of lemur from Madagascar.

children.name: Eulemur rufifrons
children.description: The red-fronted lemur (Eulemur rufifrons), also known as the red-fronted brown lemur or southern red-fronted brown lemur, is a species of lemur from Madagascar..

children.name: Eulemur cinereiceps
children.description: The gray-headed lemur (Eulemur cinereiceps), or gray-headed brown lemur, is a medium-sized primate, a cathemeral species of lemur in the family Lemuridae..

children.name: Eulemur collaris
children.description: The collared brown lemur (Eulemur collaris), also known as the red-collared brown lemur, collared lemur, or red-collared lemur, is a medium-sized strepsirrhine primate and one of twelve species of brown lemur in the family Lemuridae..

children.name: Eulemur mayottensis
children.description: A lemur endemic to Mayotte (Mahoré), the French territory in the Comoro Islands, introduced from Madagascar long before European contact — possibly by Malagasy settlers over a thousand years ago. Genetically and morphologically distinct from all Malagasy Eulemur species, probably derived from an early introduction of E. fulvus or a related species that has since diverged in isolation. Males and females are similar in colouration, brownish-grey with whitish cheek patches. The Mayotte lemur was formally described as a distinct species in 2017 based on morphological and molecular evidence. The Comoros population has no wild conspecifics, making conservation of the Mayotte population uniquely important.

children.name: Varecia
children.description: Ruffed lemurs are the largest of the true lemurs, with a distinctive ruff of long fur around the neck and face. They are unusual primates in building nests for their offspring and in their dispersed fission-fusion social system. Critical seed dispersers for large-fruited trees in Madagascar's rainforests.

children.name: Varecia variegata
children.description: The black-and-white ruffed lemur (Varecia variegata) is an endangered species of ruffed lemur, one of two which are endemic to the island of Madagascar..

children.name: Varecia rubra
children.description: The red ruffed lemur (Varecia rubra) is one of two species in the genus Varecia, the ruffed lemurs; the other is the black-and-white ruffed lemur (Varecia variegata)..

children.name: Hapalemur
children.description: Bamboo lemurs are the only primates to specialise almost exclusively on bamboo — including the highly toxic giant bamboo, which they detoxify through physiological adaptations. Five species are endemic to Madagascar and critically threatened by bamboo forest loss.

children.name: Hapalemur griseus
children.description: The eastern lesser bamboo lemur (Hapalemur griseus), also known as the gray bamboo lemur, the gray gentle lemur, and the Mahajanga lemur is a small lemur endemic to Madagascar, with three known subspecies..

children.name: Hapalemur aureus
children.description: The golden bamboo lemur (Hapalemur aureus), bokombolomena or varibolomena in Malagasy, is a medium-sized bamboo lemur endemic to south-eastern Madagascar..

children.name: Hapalemur occidentalis
children.description: The western lesser bamboo lemur (Hapalemur occidentalis), also known as the northern bamboo lemur, western gentle lemur, or Sambirano lesser bamboo lemur, is a species of bamboo lemur endemic to Madagascar..

children.name: Hapalemur alaotrensis
children.description: The Lac Alaotra bamboo lemur (Hapalemur alaotrensis), also known as the Lac Alaotra gentle lemur, Alaotran bamboo lemur, Alaotran gentle lemur, Alaotra reed lemur, or locally as the bandro, is a bamboo lemur..

children.name: Hapalemur meridionalis
children.description: The southern lesser bamboo lemur (Hapalemur meridionalis), also known as the southern bamboo lemur, rusty-gray lesser bamboo lemur, and southern gentle lemur, is a species of bamboo lemur endemic to southern Madagascar..

children.name: Prolemur
children.description: A monotypic genus containing the greater bamboo lemur, the largest of the bamboo specialists. Once thought extinct, rediscovered in 1986. Critically endangered with fewer than 100–200 individuals remaining in fragmented patches of southeastern Madagascar.

children.name: Prolemur simus
children.description: The greater bamboo lemur (Hapalemur simus), also known as the broad-nosed bamboo lemur and the broad-nosed gentle lemur, is a species of lemur endemic to the island of Madagascar..
